column_semantics: The March 31, 2026 schedule uses one Interest Rate column. For instruments with PIK and cash components, the printed Interest Rate is the all-in rate and the PIK component is shown parenthetically as included. For PIK-only instruments, the printed Interest Rate is the PIK rate itself.

rationale: The filing presents a single Interest Rate column, not separate cash and PIK columns. The clearest mixed cash/PIK row, Titan BW Borrower L.P. (dba Triumph), prints '9.04 % (incl. 2.88 % PIK)', which states that the PIK rate is included in the printed 9.04% total. The PIK-only Homerun and KPCI rows print the rate as '11.50 % PIK' and '11.00 % PIK', consistent with the same single-column all-in convention for positions whose all-in rate is entirely PIK. Searches of the rendered filing evidence for PIK, incl, and paid-in-kind did not find a separate schedule footnote defining a different convention.
